chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah and Ayub ibn Nuha from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah said: Uyaynah narrated to me from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, that he asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about praying in congregation on a ship, so he said, 'There is no harm.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no harm/It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in congregation on a ship according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) addresses the practicalities of worship during maritime travel, affirming that the standard congregational format remains valid aboard ships. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on maintaining communal unity (*jama'ah*) even in transient or challenging environments, ensuring that the spiritual benefits of collective prayer are not lost due to mobility.
